title: Edumanus Landing Page
summary: The AI Cosmos product homepage: an interactive galaxy opens into five product demonstrations, scroll-driven typography and an isometric image field.
highlights: A draggable, keyboard-accessible galaxy dissolves into the page's continuous star field.
Five product covers expand into full-page video demonstrations with chapter controls.
Scroll-driven text and an isometric image field connect the product sections.
A standalone English/Chinese edition with local assets, responsive layouts and reduced-motion fallbacks.

zh.title: Edumanus 产品首页
zh.summary: AI Cosmos 产品首页：从可交互的银河进入五组产品演示，以滚动文字和等距图片阵列串联完整页面。
highlights: 支持拖动与键盘操作的银河，随滚动散入贯穿页面的星空。
五组产品封面展开为完整视频演示，并提供章节切换。
滚动文字与等距图片阵列串联产品内容。
独立中英文版本，素材本地托管，保留响应式布局与减少动态效果的降级。
